title: Creativity in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature and benchmarks (e.g., the MALIBU Benchmark) that quantify how assigned agent personas risk amplifying stereotypes and escalating implicit bias during multi-agent interactions.
Reviewing studies that examine the use of diverse agent personas in multi-agent debates to reduce user confirmation bias on controversial issues.
Discussed as an example of a specific bias type that existing multi-agent system studies often narrowly focus on when evaluating persona-related biases.
